name: SudokuUI
summary: This is a Classic Sudoku puzzle game implemented as an MQL5 Expert Advisor with a graphical user interface. It allows users to generate, import, solve, and play Sudoku directly on the MetaTrader 5 chart. The EA includes an auto-assistant feature and configurable random seeds for puzzle generation and shuffling.
summary_zh: 这是一个在MetaTrader 5图表上实现的经典数独游戏EA，带有图形用户界面。它允许用户生成、导入、求解和玩数独谜题。EA包含自动助手功能和可配置的随机种子用于谜题生成和洗牌。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个运行在MetaTrader 5平台上的数独游戏工具。它没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑，因为它不执行任何交易操作。该EA的核心功能是创建一个SudokuDialog对话框，通过图形界面与用户交互。它支持通过随机种子参数控制谜题的生成和洗牌过程，确保谜题的可重复性。自动更新功能可以作为助手帮助玩家完成数独。整体来说，这是一个纯娱乐/工具性质的EA，与交易策略无关。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but rather a Sudoku puzzle game tool running on the MetaTrader 5 platform. It has no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic since it does not execute any trading operations. The EA's core functionality is creating a SudokuDialog object that interacts with users through a graphical interface. It supports configurable random seed parameters to control puzzle generation and shuffling, ensuring puzzle reproducibility. The auto-update feature serves as an assistant to help players solve Sudoku puzzles. Overall, this is a purely recreational/utility EA with no relation to trading strategies whatsoever.

parameters.name: _Sudoku
parameters.description: 数独文件路径，用于导入外部数独谜题
parameters.description_en: Sudoku file path for importing external puzzles

parameters.name: ShufflingRandomSeed
parameters.description: 洗牌随机种子，控制谜题数字洗牌的随机性
parameters.description_en: Shuffle random seed controlling puzzle digit shuffling

parameters.name: CompositionRandomSeed
parameters.description: 组合随机种子，控制谜题生成的随机性
parameters.description_en: Composition random seed controlling puzzle generation

parameters.name: ShufflingCycles
parameters.description: 洗牌循环次数，决定谜题洗牌的复杂程度
parameters.description_en: Shuffle cycles determining puzzle shuffling complexity

parameters.name: EliminateLabel
parameters.description: 消除标签，用于控制谜题中数字的移除方式
parameters.description_en: Elimination label controlling digit removal method

parameters.name: EnableAutoUpdate
parameters.description: 自动助手开关，启用后可自动辅助解题

pros: 提供完整的数独游戏体验，包括生成、导入、求解功能
使用随机种子参数确保谜题可重复生成，便于分享和验证
自动助手功能帮助新手玩家逐步学习数独解题技巧
图形用户界面友好，直接在MT5图表上操作
pros_en: Provides a complete Sudoku game experience including generation, import, and solving capabilities
Uses random seed parameters to ensure reproducible puzzle generation for sharing and verification
Auto-assistant feature helps novice players learn Sudoku solving techniques step by step
User-friendly graphical interface operating directly on the MT5 chart
cons: 与交易平台功能无关，占用EA槽位但没有交易价值
CODEBASE_CHECKUP宏会导致部分控制按钮不可用，影响用户体验
依赖外部BMP资源文件，部署时需要额外解压操作
没有持久化保存游戏进度的功能
cons_en: Unrelated to trading platform functionality, occupies an EA slot without trading value
CODEBASE_CHECKUP macro disables some control buttons, degrading user experience
Depends on external BMP resource files requiring extra unpacking steps during deployment
No persistence feature to save game progress between sessions
improvements: 添加游戏进度保存和恢复功能，避免重启后丢失进度
将BMP资源嵌入代码或使用MQL5原生绘图替代，减少外部文件依赖
improvements_en: Add game progress save and restore functionality to prevent data loss on restart
Embed BMP resources in code or use MQL5 native drawing to eliminate external file dependencies

risk_points: 纯工具类EA，无任何交易风险
不影响账户资金或持仓
risk_points_en: Pure utility EA with zero trading risk
Does not affect account funds or positions
